subject: Coord: Global Dedicated/Private demo — on-call DPO & APAC security availability
content:
From: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Dedicated/private demo — include EU DPO & APAC sec lead

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick discovery last week. We’re ready for a technical runthrough of Redwood’s Dedicated/Private options next week, and we need the session to include our security reviewers. Two constraints:

- EU DPO (Sarah Lopez) can only join between 14:00-17:00 CET.
- APAC security lead (based in SGT) prefers 10:00-13:00 SGT.

Both teams want to review key topics: network isolation, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, and demo of on-prem packaging. Can you propose an options list that hits the overlap window? Also attaching our SOC2 questionnaire so you can prefill answers where possible.

Attachments: [SOC2-Questionnaire_Request.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Best,
Ben
Senior IT Program Manager
Orbital Health

---
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated/private demo — include EU DPO & APAC sec lead

Ben —

Appreciate the constraints — we can absolutely include both reviewers. Quick note on DST: Europe switched back earlier this month and APAC doesn't observe DST, so the overlapping windows are tighter than they appear on a naive conversion.

Proposed slots (all times listed with local zones):
- Option A: Thu 2 Dec, 16:00 CET / Fri 3 Dec 00:00 SGT / 07:00 PST (early for us) — likely too late for APAC.
- Option B: Fri 3 Dec, 13:30 CET / 20:30 SGT / 04:30 PST — outside EU DPO window.
- Option C (best overlap): Mon 6 Dec, 14:00–15:15 CET / 21:00–22:15 SGT / 05:00–06:15 PST — hits the tail of EU DPO slot and early APAC evening.

Laura, Soojin — can you confirm APAC & EU reviewer availability for Option C? Also tagging Kimberly for any Dedicated deployment runbook changes we should surface during the demo.

I’ll prefill the SOC2 questionnaire with standard responses and share the runbook draft.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:15:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated/private demo — include EU DPO & APAC sec lead

Markus / Ben —

Confirmed with our EU DPO (Sarah) offline: she can do Mon 6 Dec 14:00–15:15 CET but only if we keep the session tightly focused (30–40 mins of demo, then Q&A). She needs the SOC2 questionnaire prefilled by EOD Fri 3 Dec.

Ben — can you confirm Sarah Lopez (cc’d) is the DPO contact? If there’s additional legal counsel joining, please flag.

Soojin — will APAC security lead accept 21:00–22:15 SGT on Mon 6 Dec? That’s late but not uncommon for APAC cross-region meetings.

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 02:42:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated/private demo — include EU DPO & APAC sec lead

Hi all —

I checked with our APAC security lead (Ravi) — he can push to join Mon 6 Dec at 21:00 SGT if the primary agenda is the Dedicated network isolation and KMS flow. He asked for the demo to avoid long deep-dive on model internals — focus on deployment, audit logs, HSM key flow, and token handling.

Kimberly — can you prepare the Dedicated runbook snippet showing the KMS/HSM handshake and the fallback routing behavior? A short run-through in our staging environment will do.

Soojin Lee
APAC Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@orbitalhealth.com>, Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@orbitalhealth.com>, Ravi Tan <ravi.tan@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:07:00 +01:00
Subject: Final: Mon 6 Dec 14:00 CET / 21:00 SGT — Dedicated/Private demo (confirmed)

Ben / Sarah / Ravi —

Thanks for accommodating the window. Final details:

- When: Mon 6 Dec 2026, 14:00–15:15 CET / 21:00–22:15 SGT / 05:00–06:15 PST
- Agenda (timed): 14:00–14:10 intro & context (Markus) / 14:10–14:40 dedicated/private deployment demo (Kimberly + staging environment) / 14:40–15:05 KMS/HSM & audit logs (Soojin) / 15:05–15:15 Q&A (all)
- Prep: I’ve attached the demo runbook draft and a prefilled SOC2 workbook — please review and send any redlines by Fri 3 Dec EOD so Sarah can review prior to the session.
- Calendar: sending invite now; Ben please accept and add any additional reviewers.

Attachments: [Demo-Runbook-v2.md (text)]

See you Monday —
Markus

---
On Mon, 29 Nov 2026 at 16:12:00 +01:00 Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@orbitalhealth.com> wrote:

Markus —

Confirmed on our side. Sarah (DPO) accepted the slot; Ravi will join from APAC. We’ll keep the attendee list tight. I’ve added a calendar placeholder and DocuSign NDA link for the session materials.

Ben
